## About Me

## About Me

I am a Ph.D. student in Political Science at the University of Houston.

My research focuses on political behavior, political psychology, and legislative politics. I am particularly interested in how citizens evaluate political representatives and how political identities and policy experiences shape public opinion.

## Research Interests

Political Behavior · Political Psychology · Public Opinion · Legislative Politics · Representation
